subject: PO billing & net-term alignment for StellarCare SOW
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: StellarCare APAC Finance <apac.finance@stellarcare.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements / invoice cadence for upcoming SOW

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the SOW looks good from a capability standpoint. Before procurement will issue a PO we need a few clarifications on billing and invoice formatting so our ERP can pick up invoices cleanly. Can you confirm the following?

- We require the PO number printed on each invoice line and the invoice header (we will provide PO 98765 once final).
- Net terms: StellarCare standard is Net 60. Will Redwood accept net60 for this contract?
- Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly invoices per legal entity (we have two billing entities for North America). If Redwood needs to split invoices by project milestone, we can accept milestone invoices but need a consolidated monthly statement to reconcile.
- Vendor fields: please include vendor tax id (EIN) and address on the invoice PDF.
- Discounting: procurement needs the committed-spend discount tiers in writing. Are the committed discounts tied to ARR bands in the pricing sheet?

Attached: blank PO template for your billing team to validate.

If you can confirm by end of week we can route the PO.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Procurement Manager | StellarCare
emily.zhang@stellarcare.com
+1 (415) 555-1223

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcare.com>
Cc: StellarCare APAC Finance <apac.finance@stellarcare.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence for upcoming SOW

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and attaching a pricing sheet and a sample invoice layout we can generate automatically.

- PO on invoice: yes, we will include the PO number on each invoice header and every line item (we can also map PO->invoice metadata for your ERP).
- Net terms: standard Redwood hosted contracts are Net 30; we can make a Net 60 exception subject to finance approval (see internal thread).
- Invoice cadence: we can produce either (a) monthly consolidated invoices per billing entity, with PO reference on each invoice, or (b) milestone invoices as deliverables. For your reconciliation ask, we can also produce an automated monthly statement that aggregates milestone invoices.
- Vendor fields: will include EIN and vendor address on PDF.
- Discounting: committed-spend/ARR bands are in the attached pricing sheet; Rafael is looping in finance to confirm the band that applies to your expected spend.

Next steps: Rafael or finance to confirm net60 exception and discount band; if approved I will send a DocuSign SOW + the billing annex for signatures.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing bands), sample-invoice-template.pdf

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood finance input: StellarCare net terms and discounts

Irene / Marissa,

Reviewing the pricing band request for StellarCare (deal SC-2026-074). A couple of notes from finance:

- Net60: acceptable as an exception for strategic healthcare customers, but we need either (1) a PO with the full committed amount on file or (2) a deposit equal to the first month if the initial invoice exceeds $75k. This mitigates receivables exposure.
- Discount bands: we can offer the listed discounts in redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx, but discounts above 18% require VP sign-off.
- Invoice splitting: finance can support milestone invoices, but for month-end close we need a consolidated statement with invoice numbers and PO mapping.

If StellarCare signs the SOW and we get the PO 98765, finance can approve Net60 under the deposit/PO conditions.

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood finance input: StellarCare net terms and discounts

Agree with Rafael. Minor addition: procurement asked explicitly for a monthly statement for reconciliation — we will produce that, but we should also include a short billing annex in the SOW that spells out:

- PO placement rules (must be provided prior to first invoice);
- Invoice header and line format (PO number, cost center, legal entity);
- Consequences for late PO issuance (billing will proceed but payment terms measured from invoice date);

Irene — I can sign off on Net60 once we get the PO and the deposit clause is included. For discounts, flag anything >18% and I'll escalate to VP Sales.

Thanks,
Marissa 
Director, Finance Partnerships | Redwood Inference

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcare.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence for upcoming SOW

Hi Emily — looping Rafael and Marissa. Based on internal approval paths here is the proposed billing approach we can include in the billing annex of the SOW:

1) PO & Net terms
   - StellarCare provides PO 98765 prior to the first invoice.
   - Redwood will accept Net 60 subject to: (a) PO provided, OR (b) a one-month deposit if initial invoice > $75k.

2) Invoice cadence & statements
   - Redwood will issue milestone invoices as deliverables.
   - Redwood will also emit a consolidated monthly statement per legal entity that lists all invoice numbers, amounts, and PO mappings for reconciliation.

3) Invoice format
   - PO on header and each line; include vendor EIN and address as requested.

4) Discounts
   - Pricing bands in attached sheet apply; discounts above 18% require VP Sales approval. Please confirm the expected ARR band so Rafael can finalize the band in writing.

I have created a billing annex draft and prepared the SOW for signature via DocuSign — link below. Also attaching the pricing sheet and a sample invoice template for your finance team to validate.

DocuSign SOW: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345/view
Attachments: SOW_StellarCare_Q3_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Can you confirm the ARR band and whether StellarCare will provide the PO before Aug 1? If yes we will route SOW for signature and schedule first invoice for Aug 1.

Best,
Irene

---

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: StellarCare APAC Finance <apac.finance@stellarcare.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements / invoice cadence for upcoming SOW

Thanks, Irene — apologies for the delay. We have approval to proceed. Confirming below: 

- StellarCare will provide PO 98765 (attached) and expects Net60. PO is attached as signed PDF.
- We will accept milestone invoices but prefer monthly consolidated statements for reconciliation.
- ARR band: expected spend maps to the 12% discount band in your pricing sheet; we do not need >18% today.
- Vendor fields: EIN and address look good on your sample invoice.

We will return a countersigned SOW via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow. Please proceed with Net60 and schedule the first invoice for Aug 1.

Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Procurement Manager | StellarCare

Attachments: StellarCare_PO_98765.pdf
